issues.objective: Inspect current /ui/mesh route and runtime implementation, discover actual UI route owner, templates, asset graph and mesh capabilities
Inventory all related PRs, issues, intents, milestones, rules, ADRs and previous UI packs; deduplicate and connect
Capture actual baseline screenshots and browser interaction traces at desktop, tablet, narrow mobile; record missing functionality
Map each node/edge UI field to canonical source, evidence availability, permissions and freshness
Record supported realtime transports, event envelope and existing execution WebSocket; identify semantic mismatch
Create canonical milestone DAG, issues, acceptance evidence and performance baseline

milestones.title: Canonical typed mesh topology and entity resolver

issues.objective: Resolve stable node/runtime/instance/stream/peer/task/capability identities, do not use hostname, address or PID as identity
Derive typed graph nodes and edges from mesh discovery, handshake, signed journal, fold, capability relation and task model
Specify observable versus trusted versus actionable node states, provenance and authorization semantics
Implement generic entity deep links, reverse links and route lookup with no consumer-specific ID lists
Generate JSON schema and data contract from canonical model; include revision, cursor, collected-at, status and absence reasons
Property and contract tests: deterministic ordering, dedupe, topology changes, churn, restarts, partitions and missing evidence
Compose existing server-rendered Cockpit /ui shell, preserve no-JS table/detail baseline and canonical route ownership
Build Cytoscape topology with pan/zoom/minimap/fit, semantic labels, clustering, layout toggle, keyboard equivalents
Click, tap or keyboard-select node to show inspector with identity, trust, health, last seen, freshness and provenance
Inspector tabs: Overview, Tasks, Sessions, Capabilities, Connections, Events, Metrics, Logs, Evidence, Actions; show only supported panels
Bidirectional selection graph-table-inspector-URL, browser back/forward, shareable deep link and restored filters
Edge inspector shows type, direction, reason, signed-event provenance, status, last observed, diagnostics and linked entities
Audit existing execution GET /events WebSocket; reuse framing/auth/heartbeats, extend using typed mesh events only if required
Define snapshot-then-subscribe with monotonic cursor, sequence, deduplication, versioned envelope and replay policy
Stream real mesh link transitions, heartbeats, claims, conflicts, handovers, reviews, task and execution progress where actually emitted
Implement per-node subscription filtering, bounded backpressure, bounded buffers, masking of secrets and explicit retention limits
Reconnect with exponential backoff, gap detection, catch-up snapshot, stale/offline badges and no fabricated activity
Test socket churn, event reorder/duplicate/gap, browser sleep, tab close, server restart and mesh partition
Derive available actions from capabilities, input schemas, runtime target and effective authorization; never invent buttons
Enable supported local actions like inspect, explain, copy link, view work, run named canonical capability through existing executor
Where remote execution is not supported, display explicit non-actionable state; design authenticated delegated execution only through reviewed existing mesh boundary
Provide schema-driven action forms, preflight, effect preview, required confirmation for destructive mutations, idempotency keys
Attach action execution ID to node, issue, task, milestone and intent as supported; display live result and evidence
Authorization and race tests for forged peer, stale trust, denied action, duplicate clicks, capability disappearance and expired delegation
Apply shared design tokens, Flowbite/Tailwind and Alpine.js within current asset pipeline; do not introduce a SPA
Create responsive split graph and inspector with mobile bottom sheet, no inaccessible drawers or hover-only controls
Add graph search, facet filters, status/category grouping, legend, view switching and state URL persistence
Use Apache ECharts only for measured time series; distinguish absent/unmeasured/stale/failed from zero
Lazy-load graph/chart libraries, scale to large meshes and benchmark rendering, event volumes and reconnect costs
WCAG keyboard/focus/contrast/reduced-motion tests and no-JS tabular rendering parity
Update canonical .ai/ rules and doctrines after existing-rule reconciliation, replace obsolete rules instead of piling on duplicates
Attach executable negative tests to every blocking invariant and wire into existing gate model and CI planner
Add cross-surface parity tests for CLI, MCP, HTTP, Cockpit, graph and node detail with identical canonical IDs
Generate OpenAPI/JSON schema and relevant docs from typed declarations; preserve stable route and asset topology
Update docs/MESH.md, Cockpit docs, operating/security guides, screenshots, ADR when repository policy warrants it
Implement no-mock/no-hardcoded-inventory drift gate, provenance coverage checks and exact path to diagnose failures
Integrate in smallest safe vertical slices, run focused tests, only affected derive, check and verify before merge
Drive PR queue through existing prs drain, respect conflicts, review and branch protection; preserve self-hosting
Apply repository version analysis, bump as warranted, regenerate version surfaces and publish authenticated release
Deploy authorized runtime and site updates, perform HTTP/WebSocket/node selection real browser smoke tests
Run independent adopter-repo scenario, healthy/empty/offline/partitioned mesh cases, mobile and accessibility validation
Produce evidence report: URL, SHA, run IDs, tests, latency, screenshots, artifacts, failures, blockers and follow-up issues
